questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive as you would on dry roads.

questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase your following distance. Your vehicle will take longer to stop.

questions.question: When a stop is required at an intersection with no stop line or crosswalk marked, a driver:

options.text: Is required to slow down to make sure crossing traffic is clear.
Should stop where they can see at least 200 feet on either side, even if they have to enter the intersecting roadway.
Should stop where they have a clear view of approaching traffic before they enter the intersecting roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should stop where they have a clear view of approaching traffic before they enter the intersecting roadway.
questions.explanation: With no stop line or crosswalk, stop closest to the intersecting roadway where you can see oncoming traffic. Do not enter the roadway to get a better view.

questions.question: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle, you must:

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Wave for the emergency vehicle to pass you.
Merge into the right lane and continue driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: Let any emergency vehicle with flashing lights or a siren pass. Drive to the right side of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then stop on the right side.

questions.question: Your vehicle hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. You:

options.text: Have done as much as you can.
Must stay until the police arrive.
Must leave a written note with your name, address, and details about the accident.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must leave a written note with your name, address, and details about the accident.
questions.explanation: Stop and try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a curve is coming.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. They control traffic and must always be obeyed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane for left turns only. You cannot use it for passing or for driving straight through.

questions.question: Your ability to stop is affected by:
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect how quickly you can stop. Slow down on slippery or poor roads to keep control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive the speed limit, with caution.
Not drive more quickly than 20 mph.

questions.explanation: Slow down when it rains, snows, or sleets. These conditions make roads slippery. You may need to drive slower than the speed limit to stay safe.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill next to a curb, set your parking brake and turn your steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: The most common color of warning signs is:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: You may park or stop along the shoulder of the freeway:

options.text: As long as you turn on your four-way (emergency) flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to look at a map for directions.
Only if you have an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if you have an emergency.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a freeway shoulder except during an emergency.

questions.question: You may continue carefully through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already within the intersection when the light changes to yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already within the intersection when the light changes to yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already inside the intersection when the light turns yellow, you can continue through carefully.

questions.question: "Highway hypnosis" is a driving condition that can result from:

options.text: Staring at the roadway for long periods of time.
Too much sleep the night before your trip.

questions.correctAnswerText: Staring at the roadway for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Highway hypnosis happens when you stare straight ahead for a long time without looking around. You stop paying attention to traffic, which makes crashes more likely.

questions.question: You come to an intersection displaying a flashing red light. You should:

options.text: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Stop only if other cars are also approaching the intersection.
Stop only if other cars are already within the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop, if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to other traffic, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: Which of the following must you obey over the other three?
questions.explanation: A police officer's directions take priority over all signs and signals. This includes police officers, fire police, construction workers directing traffic, and school crossing guards.

questions.question: When turning left, drivers must yield the right-of-way to:

options.text: Other drivers who are already in the intersection.
Pedestrians who are already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic, other drivers already in the intersection, and pedestrians already in the intersection.

questions.question: You are waiting at a stop sign behind other vehicles. The vehicles ahead pass through and there is no cross traffic. What should you do?

options.text: You can go through without stopping again.
You must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
You can slowly roll past the stop sign.
You can follow the car ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop at the stop sign or stop line before going.
questions.explanation: You must always make a complete stop at the stop sign and check for traffic before going. Do not skip this step just because other cars are moving.

questions.question: What should you do if you have a tire blowout?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not use your brakes right away.
Slow down gradually and pull to the side of the road.

questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout: Remove your foot from the gas pedal, do not brake right away, then slow down gradually and gently brake while pulling to the side of the road.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect how far it takes a vehicle to stop?

options.text: The condition and type of your tires.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after alcohol affect your blood alcohol level?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not change your blood alcohol level. It may keep you awake, but it cannot make you sober or lower your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What should you do at dusk or on overcast days?

options.text: Do not turn on any lights.

questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights at dusk or in overcast conditions. Use low beam when you are within 1,000 feet of an oncoming car or within 500 feet of a car ahead. Always use low beams in bad weather.
